scope: Mac WebKit punctuation delivered as committed input without a usable keypress, including English full stop.

fixture.baseline: Same real TerminalPane with compatibility path disabled: textarea contains period, onInput receives nothing.
fixture.fixed: Input-only event delivers exactly one period; full English punctuation and Chinese punctuation sequences also preserved.

nativeMac.terminal: Disposable local Dev terminal only; cleared and closed after verification.
nativeMac.limitation: Original failure of a physical ABC period key did not reproduce locally; input-only path reproduced and fixed. Accessibility automation text insertion is not a substitute for hardware IME validation.

release: Dev only; formal package not published.
